mapper.sql: achievement_id AS "achievementId", evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", owner_user_id AS "ownerUserId", organization_code AS "organizationCode", management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", occurred_date AS "occurredDate", achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail", certification_status AS "certificationStatus", attachment_ref AS "attachmentReference", updated_at AS "updatedAt"

sql.where: achievement.deleted_yn = 'N' AND (achievement.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings mapping WHERE mapping.user_id = #{userId} AND mapping.organization_code = achievement.organization_code AND mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mapping.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (mapping.effective_end_date IS NULL OR mapping.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE))) AND achievement.evaluation_year = #{criteria.evaluationYear} AND achievement.organization_code = #{criteria.organizationCode} AND achievement.certification_status = #{criteria.certificationStatus} AND achievement.management_item_code = #{criteria.managementItemCode}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM lecture_evaluation_achievements achievement ORDER BY achievement.occurred_date DESC, achievement.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.safeSize} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
SELECT FROM lecture_evaluation_achievements WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO lecture_evaluation_achievements (evaluation_year, owner_user_id, organization_code, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, attachment_ref, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{request.evaluationYear}, #{ownerUserId}, #{request.organizationCode}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.occurredDate}, CAST(#{request.achievementDetail,typeHandler=kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.achievement.AchievementDetailJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{request.attachmentReference}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}) RETURNING achievement_id
mapper.update: UPDATE lecture_evaluation_achievements SET evaluation_year = #{request.evaluationYear}, organization_code = #{request.organizationCode}, management_item_code = #{request.managementItemCode}, occurred_date = #{request.occurredDate}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{request.achievementDetail,typeHandler=kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.achievement.AchievementDetailJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb), attachment_ref = #{request.attachmentReference}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE lecture_evaluation_achievements SET attachment_ref = #{attachmentReference}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) VALUES ('lecture_evaluation_achievements', #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
